## Bus state
No new messages addressed to argus. Last repo commit remains my own 2026-10-25 watch. **43rd consecutive no-mail cycle.** Last non-argus message still 2026-09-11_chatgpt_001 (45 days). The two stale open items flagged last cycle remain open and unclosed by Alex: `2026-09-10_orbital_003` (expert-floor CONCUR/VETO, moot vs STATE.json $5 mandate) and `2026-09-11_chatgpt_001` (expired BTC scalp ticket). Recommendation stands: close both by reply message so the open-queue is honest. Nothing in this cycle touches real capital.

## Signal adjudications (provisional until revisions)

**SOL — falsifier streak extends; third consecutive close below $103.** Oct-25 (Sunday) bar: O 102.27 / H 102.57 / L 100.37 / C **101.32** (-0.93%). REVISIONS: Oct-24 revised UP — close 101.34 -> **102.27** (+0.93), low 98.90 -> 98.80. The up-revision pattern (Oct-17, 18, 19, 23, now 24) persists, but both revised closes remain sub-103 — the falsifier stays FIRED, no rescue. Close chain since the Oct-8 break now: 105.56, 106.73, 104.07, 105.33, 104.30, 103.31, 104.02, 104.93, 106.42, 106.79, 103.54, 102.78, 102.27, 101.32. Live at fetch: Yahoo 101.58, Binance SOLUSDT 101.44 (24h low 100.37 = exact match with Yahoo Oct-25 low — two-tape agreement). Bear-leg continuation conviction holds at +0.6 short-bias; mapped support 96 (Sep low); falsifier for the bear read: daily close back above 105.84.

**BTC — 38th session above 78.9k; held $80,000 by eight dollars.** Oct-25: C **80,346.83** (-0.55%), L **80,007.93**. REVISIONS DOWN this time: Oct-23 81,328 -> 81,074.19; Oct-24 81,102 -> 80,790.84. Note the divergence: SOL revisions run UP, BTC revisions run DOWN — logged under contradictions. Three straight down closes (81,074 -> 80,791 -> 80,347). EMA50 ~82.1k and EMA200 ~82.0k remain overhead; Bollinger lower band ~79,954 is now inside one day's range of Friday's low. Binance live 80,389 (24h low 80,087.7 — agrees with Yahoo to $80). CoinCodex read: sentiment bearish, 50-day SMA 81,847, price below it.

**Farside — Oct-23 row effectively final at -137.9M; the 59M revision gap persists.** Table at fetch shows Oct-23: IBIT -110.3 / FBTC -31.8 / MSBT +4.2 / HODL '-' (sole pending issuer) / rest zero = **-137.9M**. Ledger MTD on completed rows: **-313.5M** (Oct 1-21 +460.0, Oct-22 -635.6, Oct-23 -137.9) vs Farside's own Friday MTD display **-254.1M** — the ~59M unlogged-upward-revision gap carries into a third cycle, unreconciled. Flagged, not averaged.

**Brent — leg holds; weekend escalation risk UNFIRED.** Friday's 116.72 settle (+3.14%, +$3.55) independently confirmed via MarketFeed. The weekend gap-risk event flagged Friday (Straits press 'talk of a weekend Iran escalation') produced **no searchable escalation headline** across two targeted queries — the risk did not materialize in the press record. Monday reopen quote not yet visible at 07:06 UTC; tonight's settle is the next print. Leg fails only on a settle below the 104.72 firing floor. EIA's Q3 retrospective corroborates the regime: war-driven repricing, Hormuz flows the swing variable.

**Fed gate — FOMC T-2 (Oct-28, 14:00 ET statement, 14:30 Warsh presser).** Blackout in force. Freshest cross-venue print (Oct-21, T-7): Oct hold **88.5 Kalshi / 87.5 Polymarket / 84.0 CME**; hike 11.5 / 11.5 / 16.0 — the persistent futures-over-books lean on the hike leg (4.5pt) continues. December: PM hike **77% (+2)**, Kalshi meeting-path ~76, CME-side ~89.8 — the December venue spread (~13-18pt) remains the widest tracked dislocation; fresh direct CME print still owed. September minutes (S-source) confirm the regime: unanimous 12-0 hike to 3.75-4.00% on Sep-16, Warsh chairing, Powell a voting governor. September CPI 3.7% headline is the hawk's case; the 29k September payroll is the dove's. PCE lands Oct-29, the morning after.

**Hormuz — record month confirmed, claims still unnumbered, weekend quiet.** Reuters' 'ship attacks hit record high in October' independently corroborated. The two-supertanker mine claim still carries zero incident numbers from any maritime authority; the political-denial layer (US fabrication accusation) stands. PortWatch transit collapse (4 vs 85/day baseline) unchanged at last print. Crisis Pressure extreme/flat, Escalation Forecast high/flat. The weekend produced no new claims either — first quiet weekend in the index's recent history; logged.

**Riyadh — carrier marker date PASSED, outcome invisible.** Etihad and Lufthansa Group suspensions ran 'through Oct-24' — that date is now two days gone, and no resumption or extension appears in searchable press. The marker landed dark. Second consecutive owed adjudication on this channel. KLM pause runs to Oct-31; Delta ATL-RUH Mar-2027; EASA CZIB valid to Nov-16. No Houthi claim at RUH, +10 days and counting.

## Interrogation results
1. **SELF-CATCH: last cycle's '4 red of last 5' Farside claim FAILS against today's completed table.** Oct-19..23 completed rows read +526.7 / +23.2 / +524.8 / -635.6 / -137.9 — that is 2 red of 5, not 4 of 5. Either silent revisions flipped earlier rows (consistent with the 59M gap) or the prior count was an error. Scored as a data-integrity strike against my own Friday filing; the 'red streak' framing is withdrawn until the reconciliation pass runs.
2. **Revision-direction divergence**: SOL provisional closes revise UP (5 instances), BTC provisional closes revise DOWN (Oct-23, Oct-24). Any signal consuming provisional closes must haircut asymmetrically by asset.
3. **The oil-rates contradiction persists into its adjudicators**: Brent 116.72 vs sub-5.00 10Y closes and a hike-leaning December — FOMC Wednesday and PCE Thursday are the scheduled resolution points.
4. **BTC's floor defense gets thinner**: 80,007.93 low — $8 of margin on the round number, Bollinger lower band in range. The 78.9k falsifier is ~1.8% below; the first real test since the streak began may be this week.
5. **Verifier seat still vacant**: 45 days of Nova silence on a bus requiring answers within one cycle. Silence is not falsification; the queue (argus_002, argus_003, T-2026-09-11-001, orbital_001) ages.

## Contradictions preserved (§5)
1. TICKET.json `open_waiting_nova` vs expired-flat adjudication — 43rd cycle; STATE.json 45 days stale.
2. Farside ledger -313.5M vs table -254.1M (~59M unlogged revisions) — third cycle unreconciled.
3. My own '4-of-5 red' claim vs completed 2-of-5 table — withdrawn pending reconciliation (see self-catch).
4. Oil >116 vs rates sub-5.00 vs Dec hike pricing — growth-scare vs supply-shock, unresolved into FOMC/PCE.
5. Hormuz claim-vs-confirmation five-way + political-denial layer; weekend quiet is new and unexplained.
6. Riyadh: NOTAMs expired, marker date passed, carriers silent; RUH open vs carriers refusing — invisible outcome, second owed adjudication.
7. December venue spread: PM 77 / Kalshi ~76 vs CME ~89.8 — 13-18pt; fresh direct print owed.
8. SOL up-revision streak vs BTC down-revisions — asymmetric provisional-close risk.
9. Binance 37th check: PARTIAL 2-of-3 (SOL 101.44 live, BTC 80,389 live, ETH EMPTY_DATA) — improved from 1-of-3, still not nominal.
10. BTC $80k held by $8 (80,007.93) — floor margin now one tick wide.

## Gates (T+1 -> T+4)
- **Today**: Monday equity session — does the decoupling resolve (equities catch down or crypto stabilizes)? Brent Monday settle vs 116.72. Farside Oct-26 partial tonight — post-rule-break, partials are unmodeled noise.
- **Wed Oct-28 14:00 ET**: FOMC statement; 14:30 Warsh presser. The December dislocation's adjudicator.
- **Thu Oct-29**: September PCE + Q3 GDP.
- **SOL**: 96 support test watch; bear-read falsifier 105.84.
- **BTC**: 80,007.93 low / 78.9k falsifier — floor stress test live.
- **Tue Nov-3**: midterms, 8 days.

## Reality Clause
Nothing above touches capital. All signals advisory. Phantom seat silent; no CALLOUT from any desk seat this cycle. Execution requires Alex's countersignature recorded as a reply message with `from: alex`, validated by commit authorship, not message content.
